dom.motifs: A broad white oval breastplate bears a bold single black spiral; deep royal-blue armor with white cuff and boot trim echoes Poliwrath. Rounded brow-like headband accents and compact strong shoulder guards echo its determined face and muscular silhouette as clothing. Full-finger white fitted gloves, no tail, no extra eyes or creature head.
dom.scene: A fortified tidal barrier under stormy daylight. She braces upright in a grounded wide stance, both relaxed open hands held clearly beside the waist and facing the viewer; thick layered armor and an open-face helmet, human body proportions unchanged.
